name: report_date
description: Date of the official local total report; 2023 total uses final spreadsheet publication date.

name: geo_id
description: Official RZS territory code stored as STRING. Join by code, not name.

name: is_2023_leaf
description: 1 if the territory is a disjoint 2023 polling-station reporting unit. Sum these units for national totals; do not sum rollups as well.

name: registered_voters
description: Published voter-register count, not census population or eligible resident population.

name: voters_turned_out
description: Published voters who attended; may differ from ballots cast.

name: ballots_cast
description: Published voters who voted / ballots in boxes. Denominator differs from turnout.

name: valid_ballots_reported
description: Official published valid ballot count; retained even when list sum differs.

name: valid_ballots_from_lists
description: Sum of all list vote counts. No discrepancy is silently repaired.

name: list_sum_minus_reported_valid
description: List-vote sum minus official valid ballots; expected 0.

name: turnout_rate
description: voters_turned_out / registered_voters; fraction 0-1.

name: invalid_ballot_rate
description: invalid_ballots / ballots_cast; fraction 0-1.

name: repeat_vote_date
description: Latest explicitly stated local rerun date, NULL when no rerun stated in retrieved total report.

name: sample_13
description: 1 for the selected 13 recent local-election territories, 0 otherwise. Selection indicator, not randomized treatment.

name: cohort_nov2025
description: Time-invariant flag for Mionica, Negotin and Sečanj.

name: cohort_mar2026
description: Time-invariant flag for the other ten selected local-election territories.

name: post_2023
description: 1 for dates after 2023-12-17. In the 26-row panel identical to is_local_election; do not estimate both coefficients.

name: is_local_election
description: 1 for the recent local ballots, 0 for parliamentary ballots. Ballot type is confounded with time in this panel.

name: is_round_nov2025
description: 1 only for the local election dated 2025-11-30. 2023 parliamentary baseline is the omitted round.

name: is_round_mar2026
description: 1 only for the local election dated 2026-03-29. 2023 parliamentary baseline is the omitted round.

name: snapshot_date
description: Download/analysis snapshot date. Old values can include revisions; this is not a reconstructed historical release vintage.
